Meeting Date:                  11/16/2022
Sponsor(s):                    Burnett (27)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 1-J at 611-615 N Lawndale
                              Ave, 3658 W Ohio St and 3648-3654 W Ohio St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO;

SECTION 1.Tbe Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RT-4,
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 1-J in the area bound by:

      a line 174.67 feet north of and parallel to West Ohio Street; the alley next west of and
      parallel to North Lawndale Avenue;; West Ohio Street; a line 40.34 feet west of and
      parallel to North Lawndale Avenue; a line 99.67 feet north of and parallel to West Ohio
      Street; a line 20.15 feet west of and parallel tb North Lawndale Avenue; West Ohio
      Street; and North Lawndale Avenue,

to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                            alter Burnett Jr.
                                                          Alderman, 27*" Ward




Common Address:
611-615 N. Lawndale Avenue
3658 W. Ohio Street
3648-3654 W. Ohio Street
